'''Matt Troup Dantooine Troupers''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Matt Troup]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls46.htm Dantooine Troupers], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]).
